title: FloodGuard Notice Periods, Repetitive Loss Thresholds and Earned Premium Terms
content:
Compliance schedule for the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy. It lists, for each tier, the notice periods owed before a nonpayment cancellation or a nonrenewal, the repetitive loss thresholds, and whether the term premium becomes fully earned once a claim is paid in the term.

## Notice periods (calendar days)

| Tier | Nonpayment notice issued after the second installment's due date, once more than this many days past due | Days from nonpayment notice to scheduled cancellation | Advance notice owed to the mortgagee before a cancellation or nonrenewal | Minimum advance notice of nonrenewal to the named insured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |
| FloodGuard Essential | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |
| FloodGuard Standard | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |
| FloodGuard Plus | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |
| FloodGuard Premier | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |
| FloodGuard High Value | 15 | 10 | 45 | 45 |

## Repetitive loss and earned premium

| Tier | Paid flood claims within the lookback at which the building is nonrenewed | Smallest paid flood claim counted (USD) | Lookback (years) | Term premium fully earned once a claim is paid in the term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FloodGuard Contents Only | 2 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |
| FloodGuard Essential | 2 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |
| FloodGuard Standard | 2 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |
| FloodGuard Plus | 2 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |
| FloodGuard Premier | 3 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |
| FloodGuard High Value | 3 | 1000 | 10 | Yes |

The repetitive loss count is of paid flood claims within the lookback, each above the smallest counted claim of 1,000 USD. The count at which the building is nonrenewed is 2 on FloodGuard Contents Only, Essential, Standard and Plus and 3 on FloodGuard Premier and High Value.

## Hypothetical readings

- A hypothetical FloodGuard Essential building with two paid flood claims in the lookback, each above 1,000 USD, has reached its tier's count of 2; a FloodGuard Premier building with the same two claims has not reached its tier's count of 3.
- For a hypothetical policy whose nonrenewal takes effect at an expiration of 15 December, advance notice of at least 45 calendar days means notice no later than 31 October, both to the named insured and to the mortgagee.
